newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish industrial output growth slows in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Finnish industrial output growth slows in 1996.

text.p: Finnish industrial output growth slowed to 3.4 percent in 1996 from 7.5 percent in 1995, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Monday.
"The growth fell behind previous years due to a weak early part of the year," SF said.
The metal, engineering and electrotechnical industry led 1996 industrial production with almost six percent growth.
Production by the wood and paper industry fell 2.4 percent from 1995 due to a sluggish early half of the year, SF said.
In December, industrial production grew 8.8 percent year-on-year --- the highest monthly growth rate in 1996.
Production of pulp, paper and paper products rose more than 16 percent year-on-year in December and production of the mechanical forest industry rose 18 percent, SF said.

Production in the metal, engineering and electrotechnical industry rose slightly more than eight percent year-on-year in December with output of electrotechnical products up almost 17 percent, it said.
